author: 3owj
content: L39 done: added ManifestLock RAII guard to manifest.rs using libc::flock (no new dep). Lock acquired in top-level run() of reconcile, process, recover, init; in migrate branch of config_cmd; in reindex branch of audit_cmd. process::run calls reconcile::run_for_vault internally so lock is NOT in run_for_vault to avoid same-process deadlock. Added manifest_lock_is_exclusive test using LOCK_NB to verify exclusion without blocking. 138 tests pass.
